kebab_example: aliyun pailangstudio create-knowledge-base --workspace-id 47800 --accessibility PUBLIC --name myName --description This_is_a_description_of_the_knowledge_base. --knowledge-base-type TEXT --output-dir oss://test-bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/langstudio/output/ --data-sources oss://test-bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/langstudio/source/ --chunk-config ChunkSize=1024 ChunkDuration=30 ChunkOverlap=200 ChunkStrategy=Default --embedding-config ConnectionId=conn-r3o700000038bh Model=text-embedding-v4 --vector-db-config ConnectionId=conn-7y5y000000jja7 CollectionName=my_collection VectorDBType=Milvus --runtime-id rtime-apje000000beaz --meta-data-config '{"CustomMetaData":[{"ValueType":"String","Key":"author"}]}' --index-column-config '{"EmbeddingColumns":["column1"],"ColumnDefinitions":["column1"],"ContentColumns":["column1"]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKnowledgeBase

parameters.help_en:
The workspace visibility. Valid values:
PRIVATE: Visible only to you and administrators in this workspace.
PUBLIC: Visible to all users in this workspace
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见性，可能值为：
PRIVATE：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见
parameters.name: accessibility

fields.help_en:
The chunking strategy. Valid values:
Default: The default chunking strategy of the system.
Asr: Chunks by audio content. This value is valid only for video knowledge bases
fields.help_zh:
分块策略。支持的策略如下：
Default。系统默认切片策略。
Asr。按音频内容切分，视频知识库有效
fields.name: chunk_strategy

fields.help_en: The storage path of the source file
fields.name: uri

parameters.example: This is a description of the knowledge base.
parameters.help_en: The custom description of the knowledge base
parameters.help_zh: 对知识库进行自定义描述
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The connection ID of the index service. For more information about how to obtain the connection ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922801.html.
The connection types supported by each type of knowledge base are as follows:
Document: Model Studio large model service, general embedding model service, and AI search open platform model service.
Structured data: Model Studio large model service, general embedding model service, and AI search open platform model service.
Image: Model Studio large model service and general multimodal embedding model service.
Video: Model Studio large model service
fields.help_zh:
索引服务连接ID。如何获取连接ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2922801.html。
各类型知识库支持的连接类型如下：
文档：百炼大模型服务、通用Embedding模型服务、AI搜索开放平台模型服务。
结构化数据：百炼大模型服务、通用Embedding模型服务、AI搜索开放平台模型服务。
图片：百炼大模型服务、通用多模态Embedding模型服务。
视频：百炼大模型服务
fields.name: connection_id

fields.help_en:
The model name. Specifically, when the Model Studio large model service is selected, the models supported by each type of knowledge base are as follows:
Document: text-embedding-v1, text-embedding-v2, text-embedding-v3, and text-embedding-v4.
Structured data: text-embedding-v1, text-embedding-v2, text-embedding-v3, and text-embedding-v4.
Image: multimodal-embedding-v1.
Video: qwen2.5-vl-embedding
fields.help_zh:
模型名称。特别的，当选择百炼大模型服务时，各类型知识库支持的模型如下：
文档：text-embedding-v1、text-embedding-v2、text-embedding-v3、text-embedding-v4
结构化数据：text-embedding-v1、text-embedding-v2、text-embedding-v3、text-embedding-v4
图片：multimodal-embedding-v1
视频：qwen2.5-vl-embedding
fields.name: model

fields.name: content_columns

Can contain letters, digits, or underscores (_).
Must start with a letter.
Must be 1 to 127 characters in length

以字母开头。
长度为1~127个字符
